source: Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org), sentences with an English translation, read from the export of 2026-10-03
furigana: Readings from Tatoeba's own furigana of each sentence (written by a contributor, or by Tatoeba's software and then confirmed by kuromoji 0.1.2 (IPADIC)), each checked against KANJIDIC2 or JMdict (jamdict-data 1.5); where kuromoji's own reading is confirmed by Tatoeba's index or by JMdict giving the spelling one reading, it must agree
note: Generated by `pnpm data:sentences`: never edit by hand. Each sentence's `id` is its Tatoeba number (tatoeba.org/sentences/show/<id>), `enId` its translation's; `furigana` is its parts, `[text]` or `[kanji, reading]`, which join to `ja`.
